properties.name: The v0.26.1 version bump in reflow2.toml. `design_holds` because a version string carries no design meaning — the design meaning of a cut lives in rel:v0261 and epoch:v0261. Accepted BEFORE release_includes_all so the manifest freezes the post-bump value; doing it the other way round costs a second export (the v0.20.0 lesson, avoided twice now).
